## Residential window caulking, leak assessment and selected window hardware (no glass replacement)
- Window Repair: https://michiganslidingdoorrepair.com/window-repair
- Window Balance Replacement: https://michiganslidingdoorrepair.com/window-balance-replacement
- Window Won't Stay Open?: https://michiganslidingdoorrepair.com/window-wont-stay-open
- Single-Hung & Double-Hung Window Repair: https://michiganslidingdoorrepair.com/double-hung-window-repair
- Window Lock & Sash Hardware Repair: https://michiganslidingdoorrepair.com/window-lock-hardware-repair
Residential window services include exterior window caulking, accessible window-to-trim and window-to-siding sealant joint repair, assessment of leaks around windows, compatible channel balances, selected sash components and sash locks. Spiral or coil balance repair is not offered. Surface caulking does not resolve leaks from failed flashing, roofs or concealed siding assemblies. No glass replacement, fogged insulated glass units or whole-window installation. Verify fit, suitability and scheduling before booking.
- Window Caulking & Exterior Sealing: https://michiganslidingdoorrepair.com/window-caulking
- Window Leak Assessment: https://michiganslidingdoorrepair.com/window-leak-repair
- Window Draft Sealing: https://michiganslidingdoorrepair.com/window-draft-sealing
